runRate: Complete selected period amount divided by its month count: FY 12, YTD through the measure cutoff, YTG after its cutoff. Source amounts retain their calendar basis.
growth: Current complete amount / complete amount for the exact same months shifted back 12 - 1. Undefined or zero prior stays unavailable; numeric zero current is valid.
exclusions: Share has no run-rate or growth row. PI and net IMS have run-rate but no growth row, matching reporting_oracle.BLOCKS.
monthlyView: Run-rate rows suppressed because each column is already one month; growth compares that month with the same month last year.
limits: HTML design using synthetic observations; source code/rule lookup is not a live workbook qualification.
spacing: One small visible gap between every selected measure block, including Share and Abbott IMS, and at Sub-channel/Channel boundaries. Optional run-rate/growth rows stay within their measure block.
calendarScope: Summary period years follow the inclusive review month range. FY retains Jan-Dec and YTD/YTG retain measure-specific cutoff months; Monthly uses exact selected months.
